These are genuine conditional API bridges over supplied regularization or global-section data; they do not construct the denominator-open cover, prove base-point-freeness, or identify `Proj.fromOfGlobalSections` with `ProjectiveCoordinates.fromOpen`. There is not yet a substantive downstream consumer.
